content: Noquen bari yoshin res jisxon noquen bemanan jenquetsahpa quin non honanyamahi quescarihbihi ta Moisesnin huishani joi qui. Jaa jisxon tah non Papan noque hahxonyaxihqui non shoco res honanai, honanhihtiyamaquin. Moisesnin yohini quescabijaquin jatihibi bari jaton hinanti hinani cari carixon bi ta jascapa hinanxon jahuentianbi jaton hohcha queyobahintimahiqui.
Jascapa hinanxon jaton hohcha queyobahinxon cahen hinanyamascan. Huestijaquin jaton hohcha queyobahinti hahtipahxon cahen jaton hohcha shinanyamascan.
Jatihibi bari hinani caxon ta hinanxon, jahanbi jaton hohcha shinanrihbicaniqui.
Toro jimi, jaa hihyamahiya chibo jimi, jascapahbaan tah non jahuentianbi noquen hohcha potatimahi.
Jaa copi ta noquen neten jahuex jan nescari yohuanni joi jaiqui:

content.text: Hinantibo tah min queenyamanihqui. Jaa queenxonma bi tah min hea yorajaxonai.
Jaton hohcha copi yohina rehtexon mapojati tah min costanyamahi.
Neno tah hen qui, Papan Dios. Min huishani joi hea yohihi jai quesca, Min queenai quescajati tah hen jahui

content: hihqui jaa huisha.

Hohcha potanoxon Moisesnin yohini quescabijaquin jaibaan bi ta jascapa hinanti Papa queenyamahiqui, non yohihi quesca: Hinantibo tah min queenyamanihqui. Hohcha copi yohina rehtexon mapojati tah min costanyamahi, hihqui.
Jascaxon cahen nea rihbi yohinish: Neno tah hen qui, Papan Dios, hea yohihi miin huisha joi jai quesca Min queenai quescajati tah hen jahui, hihqui. Jan yohimenohah yamascanon ta chini joi janishqui.
Papa Dios queenai quescajaquin ta jahuen yora hinamehxon huestijaquin Jesucristonen noque sirijahiqui, non Papa qui cati hahtipahscanon.

Jonibaan hohcha copi hina rehtexon jimi hinanxonquin ta jatihibi hinanxonnicahton jaahinanihqui. Jatihibi neten nihxon ta jascapa rahsi hinanxoncaniqui. Hinanxon bi ta jascajaquin jahuentianbi hohcha potati hahtipahyamahiqui.
Criston caya, jaabi hinamehxon ta huestijaquin noquen hohcha queyobahinnishqui. Queyobahinax ta Papan mecayaho quiquin hapo sca tsahonishqui.
Papan jahuen rahuibo namanjanon caman ta jano manatihqui.
Jascabi sca siribo jahuen caisahbo janon ta huestijaquin hinamehxon noquen hohcha queyobahinnishqui. Jaa copi ta manati res jaa jaiqui.
Dios Yoshiman rihbi ta Papan joi huishamaquin jaa yohinishqui.

content.text: Hinantijaquin tah hen huetsa tian nea joibo jato nincamayaxihqui hih ta Hihbo jaiqui. Hea queenai quescati tah hen jaton jointi janin niatihi. Jointinin honanahbo tah hen huishaquin hahcajaquin heen shinanbo jaton jointi janin hihquimatihi.

content: Jato jascahax nesca sca janish:

content.text: Jaatian tah hen jaton hohchabo, jaton tiromabo hean shinanyamascatihi

content: hihqui.
Noque jascajaquin sohuaxon hohcha shinanyamascai copi tah non hina rehtexon jimi hinanti yamascai.
Papa pataxti

Papan jati janinbi non hihconon ta chique janin xehqui behna quehpenxonquin hahcajaquin jahuen yora hinamehnishqui. Xehqui quiri non pontecahini cahi quescarihbihi tah non noquen jihuetai hihbo qui cahi, Papa qui bi nocoti cahi. Papan jihue janin jahuen jihuetahbaan quiquin yohuanxonnica jaresscai quen raque potahax hihconon bonahue, hea huetsabaan.

Papan noque Benahue jaiquin honancoinax hihconon bonahue. Shinanihcamahaxma bi shinancoinax hihconahue. Non hihconon ta noquen jointibo huishcohahtaniqui, non tiromapahoni non shinanyamascanon. Noquen yora ta jene nexnanin nashimaquin hahcajahiqui.
Noque hinantijanicahton noque hinancoinyaxihqui honanquin sirijaxon caibo nincamaquin jeneyamanahue.
Hashoan sca joni huetsahon shinanxon yanapanhananahbo hihxon noquen huetsabo yohuanquihnnahue. Caibo hahxonti jato shinanmanahue.
Tsinquitaibo betan behuahi tsinquinahue. Caibo tsinquiyamahi quesca man jamis. Papan casticanti nete nocoti jahui jisish hashoan sca joni huetsa yohinannahue, jaton shinan coshijanoxon.
Noquen hohcha copi Cristo mahuanishquin honanquin sirijahax bi jaabi queenax copi non tiromahi jihuetaiya tah non huetsa hahan hohcha potati yamascai.
Hahqui raquetijaquin Papan casticanyaxihqui honanax, jaa shinanya jihuenahue. Johuehihnatai chihin nincayosmabo Papan queyoyaxihqui honanax, jaa shinanya jihueti.

Jascatimahi Moisesnin yohinih bi nincacatsihyamaxon hahresai joni tiromahi jisish chanihahbo ta jaa rehtecanpahonishqui. Rabexon jisxon, rabe hihyamaxon quimisha jonixon jisxon yohihah ta jaa tiromahi rehtecanpahonishqui, homisbaxonma rehterescanquin.

¿Jahuentiho castican cahra Cristo jama jamacaibo jatihiquin? Jato jihuemanoxon jahuen jimi Criston potanih bi ¿Criston jimi jahuama hihqui quescajahibo copi Papan jato tiromajatimahiquin? ¿Jahan shinanxon Dios Yoshiman jato hihti hahxonah bi hosanaibo copi Papan jato casticancointimahiquin?
Nea noque yohini tah non honanai: Heanbi tah hen jato copitihi. Hean tah hen jato casticanyaxihqui, hihqui. Huetsa rihbi jaa yohuanai ta nesca qui: Papan ta jahuen jonibo casticanyaxihquiqui, hihqui.
Hihcoini Papan queyoyosma mequen ta hahqui raqueti qui.
Criston joi nincacoinxon man tenepahoni shinannahue. Hihti tiromaja mato jaahbo bi tah man tenenihqui.
Caibaan ta mato hicha hichanishqui. Caibaan rihbi ta janibijaquin mato hosanhahnan tiromajanishqui, costanahbo. Jascapa tenehibo rihbi tah man yanapanniqui, hahbe tenehibo sca janoxon.

Sipo xoboho tsahonah tenehibo rihbi tah man yanapanniqui. Tiromajaquin maton jahuaborabo mato bichinahbaan bi tah man jenimahanan tenenihqui. Naihoh man hashoan siribo queyotimabo jai honanxon tah man jenimahanan tenenihqui.
Jascapahonihboxon jaa teneti shinan potayamanahue. Man tenehiya ta Papan mato hihti hahxonyaxihquiqui.
Jaa queenai quescaja man jai quen mato hahxontijani jai bihyanoxon, tenenahue.

content.text: Basima sca ta hihtihiqui. Jonicah ta joyaxihquiqui, basiyamahi.
Heen siri joni ta nincacoinax jihuetihiqui. Bahinbi jahuex bi banejaquetax jarihax jan jahui qui caribihiya tah hen jahan jenimatimahi

content: hih ta Papa jaiqui.
Jahan jan jenimayamahi yohihi ta noquenahma qui, hea huetsabaan. Bahin banetax queyotaiboma tah non qui, jointinin nincacoini queyoyamanox manataibo tah non qui.
